- Grid-based movement with local and global search phases
- Constraint-aware particle initialization and repair
- Convex relaxation with analytical gradient guidance
- Progressive refinement of precision

The particles (trial solutions) move across the discretized interval, adjusting their values to minimize the overlap integral while maintaining the integral constraint. The heuristic search phase enables global exploration, while the convex relaxation phase provides local refinement.

Stage 4: Progressive refinement
